programs.name: Computer Science BA (Hons) / MEng
programs.a_level_offer: A*A*A (minimum offer level; Colleges usually require A* in Mathematics and/or Further Mathematics)
programs.ap_offer: Typically a minimum of 5 AP scores at grade 5 in subjects related to the course, plus a high SAT or ACT and a high US High School Diploma GPA. For Computer Science the page asks for SAT 1500 combined with at least 750 Maths (or ACT composite 33, ACT Science 33) alongside APs; Calculus BC is strongly preferred. A US High School Diploma alone is not considered sufficient.
programs.required_subjects: Mathematics at A level / IB HL (IB Analysis and Approaches); Further Mathematics to AS or A level if the school offers it
programs.admissions_test: TMUA (all applicants); Peterhouse and Trinity also require CSAT
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT is not listed among Cambridge's minimum English language requirements; see the entry requirements page.
programs.english_note: IELTS Academic normally 7.5 overall, usually 7.0 in each element (or an accepted school-leaving qualification at C1 or above, or Cambridge English C2 Proficiency 200 / C1 Advanced 193, no element below 185). The College that makes the offer sets the exact condition; it is often conditional on the offer, not needed at application.
programs.notes: Entry values are for 2027 entry (course page says 2027 or deferred 2028). Course is BA (Hons) 3 years or MEng 4 years. The 2027 international tuition fee (Group 4) is GBP 46,872 per year and a College fee is charged on top for overseas students. AP route: https://www.undergraduate.study.cam.ac.uk/apply/before/accepted-qualifications and https://www.undergraduate.study.cam.ac.uk/international-students/international-entry-requirements (United States of America). Fee: https://www.undergraduate.study.cam.ac.uk/international-students/international-fees-and-costs . English: https://www.undergraduate.study.cam.ac.uk/apply/before/entry-requirements . Deadline: UCAS 15 Oct 2026, 18:00 UK time (Oxford and Cambridge); interviews follow. 2025 cycle: 14 applications per place, 128 accepted.

programs.name: Engineering BA (Hons) / MEng (general Engineering entry course)
programs.a_level_offer: A*A*A (minimum offer level; Colleges usually require A* in Mathematics and/or Further Mathematics, and often A*/7 in Physics or another science)
programs.ap_offer: Typically a minimum of 5 AP scores at grade 5 in subjects related to the course, plus a high SAT or ACT and a high US High School Diploma GPA. For Engineering the page asks for SAT 1500 combined with at least 750 Maths (or ACT composite 33, ACT Science 33) alongside APs; Calculus BC is strongly preferred and the two Physics C tests are preferred where A level Physics is asked. A US High School Diploma alone is not considered sufficient.
programs.required_subjects: Mathematics and Physics at A level / IB HL (IB Analysis and Approaches); Further Mathematics to AS or A level if the school offers it
programs.toefl_note: TOEFL iBT is not listed among Cambridge's minimum English language requirements; see the entry requirements page.
programs.english_note: IELTS Academic normally 7.5 overall, usually 7.0 in each element (or an accepted school-leaving qualification at C1 or above, or Cambridge English C2 Proficiency 200 / C1 Advanced 193, no element below 185). The College that makes the offer sets the exact condition.
programs.notes: Cambridge admits to general Engineering (not Mechanical); students specialise after the first years. Course is MEng 4 years or BA (Hons) 3 years. Entry values are for 2027 entry (or deferred 2028). The 2027 international tuition fee (Group 4) is GBP 46,872 per year and a College fee is charged on top. AP route: https://www.undergraduate.study.cam.ac.uk/apply/before/accepted-qualifications and https://www.undergraduate.study.cam.ac.uk/international-students/international-entry-requirements (United States of America). Fee: https://www.undergraduate.study.cam.ac.uk/international-students/international-fees-and-costs . English: https://www.undergraduate.study.cam.ac.uk/apply/before/entry-requirements . Deadline: UCAS 15 Oct 2026, 18:00 UK time.
